notes: 800-day two-year ruler retained; annualisation uses 365 days.
Actual daily production (800/730/10950 completed days) and native production counters; legacy T1407 uses 799/729-day buffered flow window.
Final primary matrix uses the complete24-point table and same-runner old/new OFF controls; earlier local worlds are supplemental, not mixed with remote controls.
Annual remaining stock is reference CHUNK_KG; actual skill-dependent output has a different chunk mass.
No new market balance constants, miner caps, or price tuning.
